title: Posey Chapel Cemetery: The Chapel on the Hill North of LaPorte

sources.who: University of Southern Indiana library record (A Century with Posey Chapel)

beats.text: Lights drifting between the graves, on a hill northeast of LaPorte, near Hesston. This is Posey Chapel Cemetery.
beats.label: NEAR HESSTON, LAPORTE COUNTY
beats.credit: Visitor reports: Ghost Research Society · AI-generated picture

beats.text: In 1841, settlers from the surrounding farms built a log chapel here. Local history says it was the first church in Galena Township.
beats.credit: A Century with Posey Chapel (1933) · AI-generated picture

beats.text: They named it for the circuit preacher who urged them to build it, Wade Posey. In 1855, a new chapel replaced the log one.
beats.label: 1855: A NEW CHAPEL
beats.credit: A Century with Posey Chapel (1933) · AI-generated picture

beats.text: It stood for more than a century. Then, on the night of January 26, 1972, arsonists set it on fire, and it burned to the ground.
beats.label: THE FIRE
beats.credit: A Century with Posey Chapel · AI-generated picture

beats.text: Today, a pavilion stands where the chapel was.
beats.label: THE PAVILION

beats.text: Visitors report glowing lights among the stones, and sounds they can't explain.
beats.label: WHAT VISITORS SAY
beats.credit: Visitor reports: Ghost Research Society · AI-generated picture

beats.text: It's a real cemetery. Please visit in daylight, and be respectful.
beats.label: PLEASE BE RESPECTFUL

beats.text: Comment your town, and it could be next.

end_card.pill: Visit in daylight. Respect the dead.
